item.title: EplayerX 1.2.2
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 独立版新增应用内自动更新检查，后续更新可直接下载并安装。 - 侧边栏 Pro 卡片新增更新提示：发现新版时显示青绿色按钮和白色下载箭头，悬停可查看版本。 - 更新菜单和版本提示已覆盖应用支持的全部 9 种界面语言。 - 后台更新提示不会打断播放；也可在应用菜单中手动检查更新，并选择是否自动安装。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
**1.2.1 用户请先手动下载并安装本次新版，之后即可使用应用内更新。**
## What's New
- Added in-app update checks to the standalone edition, with downloads and installation for future updates. - Added an update indicator to the sidebar Pro card: a teal button with a white download arrow appears when an update is available. Hover to see the version. - Localized the update menu and version hints in all nine supported app languages. - Background update reminders keep playback uninterrupted. You can also check for updates from the app menu and choose whether to install updates automatically.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
**If you are using 1.2.1, download and install this version manually once to enable future in-app updates.**
